steps.stepDescription: We analyse your current rankings, technical health, content gaps, and competitor positioning to build a clear picture of where the biggest revenue opportunities sit.
Based on the audit, we map out a prioritised 90-day plan targeting the keywords, pages, and fixes that will move the revenue needle fastest.
Our team handles technical fixes, on-page optimisation, content production, and link building — reporting progress against the agreed KPIs every month.
Once the system is producing results, we identify what is working and double down — expanding into new keyword clusters, markets, or content formats to compound growth.
